quotes.text: Increase an existing authorization on a confirmed PaymentIntent before you capture it.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: - [mode](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md#create_checkout_session-mode) is set to `payment` and [capture_method](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md#create_checkout_session-payment_intent_data-capture_method) is set to `manual` on the [CheckoutSession](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/.md).
You have a maximum of 10 incremental authorization attempts per PaymentIntent.

You can only perform incremental authorizations on uncaptured payments after [PaymentIntent confirmation](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/confirm.md). To adjust the amount of a payment before confirmation, use [update method](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/update.md) instead.
The PaymentIntent object remains capturable for the previously authorized amount.

findings: November 7, 2026 raw lines 5-15 retain only the common purpose statement and links to three web UI variants. The May 11, 2026 capture contains full Stripe-hosted, full embedded and advanced/Elements variants (old raw lines 8-771). Diff lines 3-774 reflect variant collapse to an index; no new eligibility, request parameter, limit or lifecycle change is established.

Old guide distinguishes a confirmed uncaptured PaymentIntent from a Checkout Session and its latest Charge: Checkout Session payment mode plus manual capture are explicit requirements (old raw lines 16-26, 383-395), and advanced path uses a card PaymentIntent with confirm:true, capture_method:manual and if_available (old raw lines 668-701). Requesting if_available does not guarantee availability; check latest_charge.payment_method_details.card.incremental_authorization.status (old raw lines 163-187, 515-540, 701-727). The current source's API section lines 40-44 omits the manual-capture and post-confirmation boundaries.

The May guide says up to 10 incremental authorization attempts per PaymentIntent, including attempted failures, not ten successful increments (old raw lines 333-349, 542-558, 729-745). Current source line 47 and concept line 41 say '10 increments'; both need a baseline correction. The request amount is the new total rather than the delta; successful increment increases authorization, failed card_declined leaves the previous amount capturable and unsaved ancillary updates, and separate capture remains necessary before the original hold expires (old raw lines 333-363, 729-758).

The old hosted and embedded Checkout Session examples set payment mode and if_available but omit capture_method:manual (old raw lines 134-155, 484-507), despite the guide's explicit manual capture prerequisite (old raw lines 16-26, 383-395). Treat this as a dated internal example/prerequisite conflict, not evidence that automatic capture works. Its hosted section also includes embedded mount/return material (old raw lines 190-331); the November index does not resolve that presentation ambiguity.

The related concept collapses beta networks into 'CNP only' (wiki/concepts/stripe-incremental-authorization.md:22), while the old table gives Diners Club card-present support in US/CA/UK and card-not-present support elsewhere, and UnionPay/JCB card-not-present support only (old raw lines 46-55, 623-632). That is a pre-existing concept error, distinct from the November raw change.
historical_claims_to_preserve: May 11, 2026 IC+ pricing access, network/merchant category and beta limits including Mastercard MX/JP-JPY and AmEx issuer status: old raw lines 14-55, 592-633.

May 11, 2026 SCA-country 3DS initial authorization, automatic off-session configuration, later MIT potentially SCA-exempt without MIT liability shift, customer disclosure and applicable consent duties: old raw lines 57-91, 634-666.
May 11, 2026 request/status/attempt/cap/failure/capture lifecycle: old raw lines 163-187, 333-375, 515-584, 668-771. These are dated guide claims, not renewed by the November variant index.
May 11, 2026 statement presentation: separate pending entries before capture, one final captured entry afterward (old raw lines 12, 381, 590); not proof of settlement or funds availability.
conflicts: Old guide says Checkout requires capture_method:manual (old raw lines 20, 389), but its own hosted and embedded creation samples omit that parameter (old raw lines 134-155, 484-507). Add reciprocal qualification around prose and samples; do not infer eligibility from the snippets.

Current source says max 10 'increments' (wiki/sources/source-stripe-incremental-authorization.md:47), and concept repeats that (wiki/concepts/stripe-incremental-authorization.md:41), while old raw explicitly says max 10 attempts (old raw lines 337, 546, 733).

Concept's beta-networks 'CNP only' statement (wiki/concepts/stripe-incremental-authorization.md:22) conflicts with Diners Club card-present beta row in old raw lines 52 and 629; current source line 29 preserves the card-present row. Reciprocal correction needed.
unresolved_questions: The three November variant URLs (new raw lines 13-15) were not captured here; current availability, actual UI samples and API behavior at those URLs are unverified.

findings: Add November base-URL index as navigation-only provenance while preserving May detailed guide; change source line 47 from ten increments to ten attempts; add Checkout payment/manual-capture and advanced confirmed/uncaptured prerequisites from old raw lines 20, 389, 668-701; preserve availability status check and separate capture boundary.
conflicts: Disclose old guide's own manual-capture prose versus Checkout code-example omission (old raw lines 20, 134-155, 389, 484-507); coordinate concept correction of its beta CNP-only line 22 against the Diners card-present row (old raw line 52).
source_assessments.reason: The November raw establishes only navigation, but the mapped summary has material baseline accuracy and provenance gaps.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/incremental-authorization, the complete November capture establishes only that incremental authorization increases an existing authorization on a confirmed PaymentIntent before capture, plus links to Stripe-hosted, full embedded and advanced web variants (new raw lines 5-15). The May guide says IC+ access, eligible card networks and merchant categories, Checkout payment mode with manual capture, or an advanced confirmed uncaptured card PaymentIntent with if_available requested (old raw lines 14-55, 668-701). Check the latest Charge's card incremental_authorization.status before attempting the PaymentIntent increment endpoint; send a new total, not a delta. A successful increment changes the authorized amount, while failure retains the previous capturable amount; a separate capture must occur before the original authorization expires (old raw lines 163-187, 333-363, 701-758). source-stripe-incremental-authorization.md mostly summarizes the May guide but omits key prerequisite boundaries and incorrectly calls ten attempts ten increments.
answers.Q2: The November change at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/incremental-authorization is navigation and capture presentation: new raw lines 9-15 list variants; old raw lines 8-771 contain detailed examples, tables and limits. No substantive eligibility or API change is demonstrated. Keep the May-dated IC+ and network conditions, SCA/3DS and MIT qualifications, ten-attempt limit, per-increment cap, separate capture and unchanged expiration (old raw lines 14-91, 333-375, 592-666, 729-771). source-stripe-incremental-authorization.md needs November index provenance and baseline correction. The old Checkout samples omit manual capture despite its explicit prerequisite, and the concept wrongly labels all beta-network support CNP only; both need reciprocal warnings or correction. A Checkout return, availability status or increased authorization does not establish capture, settlement or funds availability; linked variants were not read here.
